name: TrueCalci Precision Calculation Server
description: Deterministic quantitative finance, structural engineering, kinematics physics, and global multi-regional tax calculation tools for AI agents.

tools.name: truecalci_mortgage_piti
tools.description: Calculates exact monthly Principal, Interest, Property Taxes, Homeowners Insurance (PITI), and automated Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) for US real estate loans with amortized schedules.

tools.name: truecalci_black_scholes
tools.description: Computes closed-form analytical Black-Scholes-Merton option prices and Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, Rho) for European call and put options.

timeToExpiryYears.description: Time to expiration T in years

tools.name: truecalci_beam_bending
tools.description: Calculates maximum deflection, maximum bending moment, and extreme fiber stress for an Euler-Bernoulli simply supported structural beam.

loadNewtons.description: Point load at mid-span in Newtons

elasticModulusGpa.description: Young's modulus in GPa (e.g. 200 for structural steel)

momentOfInertiaCm4.description: Area moment of inertia in cm^4

distanceFromNeutralAxisMm.description: Distance from neutral axis to extreme fiber in mm

tools.name: truecalci_projectile_motion
tools.description: Calculates total flight time, maximum horizontal range, and apogee height for 2D ballistic projectile motion under standard terrestrial gravity.

initialVelocityMs.description: Initial launch velocity v0 in m/s

launchAngleDegrees.description: Launch angle theta above horizontal (0 to 90 degrees)

tools.name: truecalci_linear_regression
tools.description: Fits an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) linear regression model y = mx + b, calculating slope, intercept, Pearson correlation coefficient r, and R-squared.
